R7AH-duck-backcountry-0003.name: Unnamed wetland by Davis River

R7AH-duck-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Shovel 8500 Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: About 6 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Davis River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 790 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 128 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.65625, -124.48448, pull off on Shovel 8500 Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.7 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 116 m, about 145 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 80 m SE of the spot at 795 m (56.70272, -124.41572). Water: unnamed lake 30 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-37, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-37: about 782 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.12 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
